    Where are the GRAMMYs taking place in 2026?
    The 2026 GRAMMYs, officially known as the 68th Annual GRAMMY Awards, will take place Sunday, Feb. 1, live at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. Music's Biggest Night will broadcast live on the CBS Television Network and stream live and on demand on Paramount+.

    8-11:30 p.m. ET
